title: Hongzhi, Part 1: Introduction
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of embracing simplicity and letting go of self-improvement efforts, instead encouraging practitioners to simply "be" and embody the practice without trying to figure out how to do it. This approach is rooted in the idea that true understanding and insight arise from a trusting and faith-based approach, rather than individual effort or analysis. By cultivating a sense of non-doing and being like water, practitioners can let go of attachments and ego, finding harmony with others and embracing uncertainty and imperfection.
